text: Area residents have contacted my office with concerns over the length of the 'no parking' regulation on the south side of Mackenzie Crescent, immediately west of Lisgar Street. Currently, there is a 15 metre 'no parking' from corner rule on Mackenzie Crescent, west of Lisgar Street and a 9 metres 'no parking' from corner rule on Lisgar Street, immediately south of Mackenzie Crescent. The purpose of this motion is to reduce the length of the 15 metre from corner 'no parking' rule to 9 metres, which will allow for additional parking on the street.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Prohibited parking at all times on the south side of MacKenzie Crescent, between Lisgar Street a point 9 metres further west.
